scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:init: export MYSQL_PWD='MyNewPassword123!' && mysql -u root -e 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS hospital_db; CREATE DATABASE hospital_db;' && mysql -u root hospital_db < database/schema.sql && mysql -u root hospital_db < database/triggers.sql && mysql -u root hospital_db < database/seed.sql && mysql -u root hospital_db < database/views.sql && mysql -u root hospital_db < database/procedures.sql && mysql -u root hospital_db < database/indexes.sql
scripts.start: cd server && npm start & cd client && npm run dev
